facts.fact: AIB reports that the Assemblee legislative du Peuple adopted on 3 August 2026 the bill creating ARCOD, said to follow the adoption of the new personal data protection legislation; no promulgation is stated.

facts.fact: AIB reports that ARCOD, merging the CSC and the CIL, is created by the bill adopted on 3 August 2026, with a first collège still to be formed.

facts.fact: AIB reports the legislature adopted new personal data protection legislation and the law creating ARCOD as the single data protection regulator on 3 August 2026.
